attempts.label: 01-success-off

motion.limitation: Finite differences of recorded control-rate TCP samples; overlapping return windows are not independent trials. Curved intentional movement can contribute. No statistical success-rate claim.

notes: Video frame i shows the post-control state at (i+1)*dt. Seek uses encoded time i*dt; playback clock excludes startup and HTTP wait.
TCP/reference/target use robot-base metres; object/goal use world metres. They must not be subtracted across frames.

ramp_accounting.limitation: A fraction=1 desired endpoint is not proof the actual TCP reached it. Bypassed first moves and grasp/release are not counted as ramps.

measurement_contract.physics: pre-integration measured TCP/joints each 5ms plus final native post-control sample; verify 4 ordered substeps per control
measurement_contract.derivatives: forward position finite differences; no filtering/resampling; first acceleration/jerk stencil invalid; group after full contiguous-range differentiation
